'''Rod Latham Endor Mains''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls81.htm Endor Mains], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001216175500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls81.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
